description: Bind a named image to a template. Required: template_id (or key), name (the placeholder, e.g. LOGO_B64), document_id (a file already uploaded via upload_document / create_document_upload_url). The NAME is the interface, not the storage path — so the file behind it can be replaced without touching the template.

name.description: Placeholder name the image is bound to in the template, e.g. LOGO_B64

name: attach_template_asset
